+from sqlalchemy import create_engine
+from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, sessionmaker
+
+DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///:memory:"
+
+engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
+SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
+Base = declarative_base()
+
+
+def get_db():
+    db = SessionLocal()
+    try:
+        yield db
+    finally:
+        db.close()

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    Boolean,
+    Column,
+    DateTime,
+    Float,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Integer,
+    String,
+    Text,
+    UniqueConstraint,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import relationship
+
+from pilot.app.backend.db import Base
+
+
+def generate_uuid() -> str:
+    return str(uuid.uuid4())
+
+
+class User(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "users"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    email = Column(String(255), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
+    password_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+
+    documents = relationship("Document", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    generated_exams = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    exam_sessions = relationship("ExamSession", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    mastery_records = relationship("LongitudinalMastery", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class Document(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "documents"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)

+    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
+    doc_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
+    storage_path = Column(String(512), nullable=True)

+    __tablename__ = "exam_blueprints"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)

+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)

+class GeneratedExam(Base):

+

+from datetime import datetime

+

+
+

+
+
+class JobStatusResponse(BaseModel):
+    job_id: str
+    status: str

+
+
+class ExamGenerationRequest(BaseModel):
+    source_blueprint_id: str

+
+

+    prompt: str

+
+
+class ExamDetailResponse(BaseModel):
+    exam_id: str
+    title: str
+    total_questions: int
+    questions: List[ExamQuestionItem]
+
+
+class SessionStartResponse(BaseModel):
+    session_id: str

+
+
+class AnswerItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    student_answer: str
+
+
+class SaveAnswersRequest(BaseModel):
+    answers: List[AnswerItem]
+
+
+class SaveAnswersResponse(BaseModel):
+    status: str
+    last_saved_at: datetime
+
+
+class EvaluationItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    score: float
+    max_score: float
+    is_correct: bool

+
+
+class ExamReportResponse(BaseModel):
+    session_id: str
+    total_score: float
+    earned_score: float

+
+
+class StudySummaryRequest(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    focus_topics: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class StudySummaryResponse(BaseModel):
+    summary: str
+    key_points: List[str]
+    formulas: List[str]
+
+
+class TopicMasteryItem(BaseModel):
+    topic: str

+    status: str
+
+
+class RemediationRecommendationItem(BaseModel):

+
+class ReadinessDiagnosticsResponse(BaseModel):

+    topic_mastery: List[TopicMasteryItem]

+from sqlalchemy import inspect
+from pilot.app.backend.db import Base, engine
+from pilot.app.backend.main import app
+
+
+def test_database_schema_initialization():
+    Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
+    inspector = inspect(engine)
+    tables = set(inspector.get_table_names())
+    expected_tables = {
+        "users",
+        "documents",
+        "exam_blueprints",
+        "generated_exams",
+        "questions",
+        "exam_sessions",
+        "exam_answers",
+        "longitudinal_mastery",
+    }
+    assert expected_tables.issubset(tables)
+
+
+def test_openapi_contract_generation():
+    openapi_schema = app.openapi()
+    assert openapi_schema["info"]["title"] == "AI-Powered Adaptive Exam Preparation System API"
+    paths = openapi_schema["paths"]
+    expected_endpoints = [
+        "/health",
+        "/api/v1/documents",
+        "/api/v1/documents/{document_id}",
+        "/api/v1/documents/{document_id}/decompose",
+        "/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}",
+        "/api/v1/exams/generate",
+        "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}",
+        "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}/sessions",
+        "/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/answers",
+        "/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/submit",
+        "/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/report",
+        "/api/v1/study/summarize",
+        "/api/v1/diagnostics/readiness",
+    ]
+    for endpoint in expected_endpoints:
+        assert endpoint in paths
